data.description:
## Description

**What**: Refactor of `plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh` to remove all hardcoded model strings and direct provider API calls, delegating instead through `llm-api-call.sh` with tier-aware model selection per call site.
**Why**: Closes the structural gap between the CI runner and the new provider-abstraction layer, making provider switching a config change rather than a code change.
**Scope**:
- IN: ci-llm-review-runner.sh refactor (delegate all LLM calls); tier-aware per-call-site model lookup; removal of `DSO_LLM_MODEL` references in the runner; integration test against fixture diff under `model.provider=anthropic`; updates to existing test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh assertions
- OUT: Helper implementation (P2-S1); workflow file changes (P2-S3); overlay agent prompts and dispatch logic (out of epic scope — local Anthropic-pinned per epic boundary)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` contains zero hardcoded model strings, zero direct `curl https://api.anthropic.com/...` calls, and zero references to `DSO_LLM_MODEL` (verified by grep at story close)
  ← Satisfies: "Runner refactored to delegate"
- When this story is complete, all former curl sites in the runner — light path, deep tier 3 specialist calls, deep tier arch synthesis call, and any overlay dispatch curl calls — delegate to `llm-api-call.sh`
  ← Satisfies: "Runner refactored to delegate"
- When this story is complete, the runner is tier-aware — light, standard, and deep paths each pick their own model via per-tier config lookup, not via a single shared MODEL variable
  ← Satisfies: "Runner refactored to delegate"
- When this story is complete, an integration test against a fixture diff with `model.provider=anthropic` and default keys produces a `reviewer-findings.json` that passes the existing JSON schema with all 5 dimension scores populated; the existing `tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh` is updated to assert the delegation pattern (no direct curl, no hardcoded models)
  ← Satisfies: "Runner refactored to delegate"
- unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Per-tier model lookup must happen once per call site (not once per script) so light/standard/deep paths actually use distinct models on the same review run
- [Testing] Existing test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh assertions need updating for the delegation pattern — old assertions about direct curl shape will fail
- [Reliability] Recent fixes (commits beef691a89, 5cf21b075c, 8b5792f4fe, 9ceac4c04a) added explicit fail-open handling for empty Anthropic API responses, unparseable reviewer-findings JSON, truncated overlay dispatch, and inconclusive main tier; each guard inspects a response shape that is now provider-dependent — verify each guard either operates on the post-normalization shape from llm-api-call.sh OR is updated to handle the OpenAI variant of the same condition (empty choices array, content_filter finish_reason, finish_reason=length truncation)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a CI maintainer, I can rely on ci-llm-review-runner.sh to read tier-keyed model IDs from config and delegate all LLM calls through llm-api-call.sh
